Name: Clint Buys Your Weapons and Rings
Author: ASLaneZero
Description:
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/33994/33994-1749854735-357153918.png[/img][/center]
[list]
[*]In the same vein as [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21578]Willy Buys Back Your Rods[/url]﻿, does exactly what it says on the tin!
[*]You are now able to sell unwanted equipment (Weapons and Rings) to Clint.
[*]Note this does not include Boots (he's a blacksmith, not a leatherworker) or Trinkets (which are somewhat out of Clint's wheelhouse).
[/list]
This mod is included in the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/34612]Mini-Mods Pack[/url] (though a download/endorse is always appreciated)!
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/33994/33994-1749854741-2034323494.png[/img][/center]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6+
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿
[/list]
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/33994/33994-1749854747-2111067723.png[/img][/center]
[list]
[*]If installing manually, delete the previous version and extract [b][CP] Clint Buys Your Weapons and Rings[/b] to your mods folder.
[*]If using Mod Organiser, load the .zip file into your mod manager of choice and install as usual.
[*]If using a different mod manager... do whatever it is you usually do!
[/list]
[u][center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/33994/33994-1749854756-218482539.png[/img][/center][/u]
As of v1.2.0, explicitly compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/33422]Willy and Clint buy more items[/url]﻿ by [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/bananasalmon]bananasalmon[/url]﻿.

[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/33994/33994-1749854766-398538940.png[/img][/center]
